title: SHOPLINE Selects Splitit to Bring Card-Linked Installments to Hundreds of Thousands of Merchants Worldwide
summary:
Splitit, the global leader in card-linked installment payments, today announced that SHOPLINE, one of the world's leading commerce Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms, has selected Splitit as its card-linked installment partner. Through the partnership, Splitit's technology will be embedded directly within the SHOPLINE platform, enabling merchants to seamlessly activate installment payments while allowing consumers to pay over time using the available credit on their existing payment cards.
SHOPLINE has emerged as one of the fastest-growing global commerce platforms, serving more than 700,000 merchants across Asia-Pacific, Europe, North America and the Middle East. The platform provides merchants with a comprehensive suite of commerce capabilities, including ecommerce, social commerce, point-of-sale, customer engagement, live commerce and cross-border selling, helping brands launch, operate and scale globally.
By embedding Splitit's installment capabilities directly into the SHOPLINE platform, merchants can activate Splitit with minimal implementation effort through a plug-in, allowing merchants to increase sales conversion, improve average order value and strengthen customer lifetime value without disrupting their existing checkout experience or customer relationships.
The partnership addresses one of the most significant opportunities in global ecommerce today. Increasing numbers of brands across Asia, Europe and other international markets are expanding their direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses into the United States and other global markets. As cross-border ecommerce continues to grow rapidly, merchants are increasingly seeking localized payment experiences that improve conversion while preserving their own brand and customer relationships.
Card-linked installments have become an increasingly important capability for merchants selling into mature credit markets such as the United States, where consumers already have significant available credit. Rather than requiring shoppers to apply for a new loan, Splitit unlocks the purchasing power they already have through a frictionless, one-click, merchant-branded experience. More than simply adding another payment option, SHOPLINE and Splitit will optimize conversion on higher-value purchases by presenting installment offers across the shopper journey.
The partnership also reflects Splitit's strategy of embedding its technology within leading commerce platforms, marketplaces and payment ecosystems, dramatically simplifying merchant adoption while extending its reach through trusted software providers.
"Commerce platforms have become the primary distribution channel for innovation in ecommerce," said John Beisner, Head of Acceptance Partnerships at Splitit. "We're delighted that SHOPLINE has selected Splitit as its card-linked installment partner. Together, we're enabling hundreds of thousands of merchants to offer a seamless, installment experience that helps drive sales. Rather than requiring merchants to build or integrate another payment solution, Splitit becomes a native capability of the SHOPLINE platform, making adoption effortless while delivering meaningful commercial value."
Kimi Gong, General Manager of Payment at SHOPLINE, said, "Our mission is to deliver an end-to-end payment solution that help merchants grow their business worldwide. Partnering with Splitit allows us to embed a powerful installment capability directly into the SHOPLINE platform, giving merchants another proven tool to increase sales, improve customer conversion and deliver a better shopping experience. We believe this partnership further strengthens our platform while creating meaningful value for our merchants worldwide."
For SHOPLINE merchants, the partnership represents immediate access to a globally recognized installment solution. For Splitit, the partnership significantly expands its distribution strategy by making its technology available to hundreds of thousands of merchants through a single strategic platform integration.

title: Lumin Digital Launches the M&A Readiness Advantage, the Industry’s First Purpose-Built M&A Framework for Financial Institutions
summary:
Lumin Digital, the Compounding Growth Platform for banks and credit unions, today launched the M&A Readiness Advantage, the first end-to-end M&A framework offered by a platform provider in financial services. The M&A Readiness Advantage helps financial institutions scale through acquisition without compromising user experience or growth momentum.
The framework covers every phase of an acquisition from early discovery through post-launch stabilization, bringing structure and consistency to a process that is often fragmented. While many providers offer data conversion services or point-in-time support, few address the full lifecycle. The M&A Readiness Advantage closes that gap by formalizing the approach Lumin has refined over years of guiding clients through acquisitions of varying size and complexity.
“Acquisitions are defining moments for financial institutions, and the digital experience is where members and customers feel the impact first,” said Lisa Daniels, Chief Operating Officer at Lumin Digital. “The M&A Readiness Advantage brings the operational discipline and client partnership we’re known for to this critical moment, giving our clients a structured path to grow through acquisition while protecting the experience their users rely on. Lumin has guided clients through acquisitions of all sizes on a single, modern architecture, and that foundation is what allows us to deliver this kind of consistency and confidence at every phase.”
Consumers Credit Union (CCU), a $3.5 billion institution based in Lake Forest, Illinois, has completed multiple mergers on the Lumin platform. Most recently, CCU merged with KCT Credit Union, bringing more than 20,000 retail users and over 120 businesses onto the Lumin platform in a single conversion weekend.
"Growth through acquisition is an important part of our strategy at Consumers, and having a digital banking partner that can execute on that consistently is critical," said Sean Rathjen, CEO of Consumers Credit Union. "Lumin's team brings the same level of discipline and preparation to every transaction. The process is structured, the data work is thorough, and the member experience is protected throughout."
The M&A Readiness Advantage framework is organized across five phases: discovery and planning, data and conversion strategy, platform configuration and readiness, user experience strategy, and launch and post-launch support. Each phase is led by a dedicated implementation team working closely with the financial institution, with a focus on early risk visibility, rigorous data validation, and onboarding strategies tailored to the transaction.
Lumin’s cloud-native, purpose-built architecture plays a central role in enabling this approach. Because every institution operates on a single, modern codebase, new users can be onboarded without the integration challenges and fragmentation that often slow acquisitions on legacy or assembled systems. This foundation allows Lumin to deliver consistent execution regardless of transaction size.
The M&A Readiness Advantage is a pillar of the Lumin Breakaway Advantage, Lumin's client partnership program that complements the Compounding Growth Platform and is available to every Lumin client. The Breakaway Advantage works in concert with the platform, pairing Lumin’s cloud-native technology with expert execution to drive the compounding growth and high NPS Lumin is known for. While the Compounding Growth Platform delivers the technology foundation and product capabilities, the Breakaway Advantage provides the expert-led partnership support that enables financial institutions to maximize the value of the technology across the moments that matter most. Additional forthcoming Lumin Breakaway Advantage pillars will address other critical areas of a financial institution’s growth strategy.

title: Minor Hotels Partners With Checkout.com to Power High-Performance Payments Across Global Hospitality
summary:
Checkout.com, a leading global digital payments company, today announced its partnership with Minor Hotels, a global hospitality group with more than 640 hotels across 67 countries.
Minor Hotels operates a diverse portfolio of hotels and resorts, alongside food and beverage businesses and luxury transportation services. As the group continues to expand across markets, it is consolidating its payments infrastructure to create a consistent foundation for growth and ensure high quality digital payment experiences for guests.
Through the partnership, Checkout.com will provide global acquiring and payment optimization capabilities for Minor Hotels’ resort properties across multiple markets worldwide. Minor Hotels selected Checkout.com for its global reach and local expertise, and its ability to deliver payment performance across multiple international markets while adapting to local requirements. Checkout.com’s domestic acquiring capabilities improve authorization rates and reduce processing costs through local transaction routing. Where possible, like-for-like settlement in local currencies reduce unnecessary foreign exchange conversions and simplify treasury and reconciliation as Minor Hotels scales.
The partnership will also bring together Checkout.com’s Intelligent Acceptance and Dynamic 3DS Authentication capabilities. Intelligent Acceptance is Checkout.com’s AI-driven optimization engine that enhances the performance of every transaction and is powered by global network intelligence. It maximizes first-attempt approvals and reduces failed transactions, helping to drive revenue across complex cross-border and multi-currency payment flows. Dynamic application of 3DS authentication is based on issuer preferences and local regulatory requirements, reducing unnecessary friction for guests.
Anthony Green, Global Head of Digital Marketing and Ecommerce at Minor Hotels, said: “As our portfolio continues to grow across markets, we need payment infrastructure that is reliable, flexible and able to support a premium experience for our guests. Checkout.com’s global acquiring capabilities and payments expertise will help us simplify complexity, improve performance and build a stronger foundation for our next phase of growth.”
Yao Xiang, Head of Commercial, Greater China and Southeast Asia at Checkout.com, said: “Hospitality businesses operate across complex payment flows, markets and currencies, while guests expect every payment to be simple and secure. title: Ecommpay Launches QR Code Payments for Customer-Defined and Preset Amounts
summary:
Enabling merchants to collect variable one-off payments such as tips and donations, inclusive global payments platform, Ecommpay, has launched QR Code Payment. The new solution provides a single static QR code which merchants can display anywhere, whether on a printed sign, a receipt, or a web page. Payment amounts can be preselected or set by the consumer, and payment can be made using any available method, for significant flexibility.
Critically, the QR code is created, customised and published directly from the Ecommpay dashboard without development or integration work or coding required. And delivered on a fully merchant-branded Hosted Payment Page, the payment journey provides the customer with a consistent and trustworthy experience whether they are leaving a tip in a restaurant, donating to charity or paying a micro-merchant.
“We have built QR Code Payments to make it quick and simple to send one-off payments – the digital equivalent to leaving a £5 note tucked under a glass when you leave the table or throwing a few coins into a collection bucket as it passes,” commented Artus Zaremba, Head of Payment Solutions, Ecommpay. “Fewer customers carry cash today, so servers and charities can miss out even if someone wants to leave a tip or make a donation. With QR Code Payments, merchants and charities can display a static QR code to help capture these payments.
“This latest enhancement also provides a simple solution for small or micro-businesses to accept payments without using a card machine – for example, pay-as-you-go bootcamp sessions in the local park, or selling goods at a farmers’ market or school fair. The merchant can choose whether they or the customer sets the amount and choose which payment methods are made available. They also set the look and feel of the payment page, ensuring they are in full control, and customers get the best experience, and the same QR code can be used indefinitely, until deactivated by the merchant.”
Key features
Compatible with all payment methods available with Ecommpay.
Supports 3DS authentication and AVS check.
Static QR code / payment link - A single reusable QR code that opens an own-branded Ecommpay payment page, QR code can be used on printed materials, physical signage or online.
Pre-checkout Page - A customised customer-facing page for entering or selecting the payment amount before being redirected to make payment - merchant configures the amount-selection mode per link, in one of three options: custom amount only, preselected amounts only, or preselected amounts plus a custom-amount option. The merchant also controls branding including logo, background image, title, description, action-button text and thank-you page.
Dashboard lifecycle management – Full self-service control of the QR code: creation, customisation, copy/download, and deactivation, limited to merchant admin and operations roles.Please

title: Nexi Partners With JCB and UnionPay International to Simplify Public Transport in Campania
summary:
Nexi, the European PayTech leader, announces two strategic partnerships with JCB and UnionPay International (UPI) to expand both global payment schemes across public transport in the Campania region of southern Italy, including Naples. The partnerships are delivered through the Unico Campania consortium, which manages integrated ticketing for multiple public transport operators in the region.
Thanks to these agreements, millions of tourists holding JCB and UnionPay cards, particularly from Asia, will be able to use the Tap & Go service, allowing them to access public transport and purchase tickets simply by tapping their contactless payment card or smartphone at enabled gates and ticket validators. The service will be available across a wide range of metro lines, funiculars and buses across the region.
In addition, JCB and UnionPay cards will be accepted throughout Unico Campania’s entire ecosystem, including physical ticket offices.
For passengers, the service delivers several key benefits, including: no need to purchase tickets in advance, greater convenience and enhanced security, automatic best fare calculation based on journeys taken within 24 hours, and smoother access to public transport.
The agreements between Nexi and JCB and UnionPay International represent a significant step forward in the digitalization of urban mobility in the Campania region, once again highlighting how digital payments are a key enabler in the transformation of public services for citizens.
“The new service launched in the Campania region together with JCB and UnionPay International demonstrates our ability to bring the best payment solutions to local communities across Italy, leveraging both our technology and our strong partnerships with global players - said Filippo Maria Signoretti, Merchant Solutions Director at Nexi - These agreements also allow us to support the digitalization of services for citizens, with mobility representing a key element in this transformation”.
Hiroyuki Katano, Executive Vice President, JCB International Co., Ltd., said: “We are pleased to partner with Nexi and Unico Campania to expand JCB acceptance across public transport in the Campania region in southern Italy, including Naples and surrounding areas such as Pompeii. This will make it easier for JCB Cardmembers, particularly from Asia to access transport services seamlessly using contactless payments, without the need to purchase tickets in advance. By enabling simple and familiar payment experiences, we aim to enhance convenience for travellers while helping local operators capture growing international demand”.
James Yang, Executive Vice President of European Region, UnionPay international, said: “We are pleased to support the expansion of digital mobility services in the Campania region through this collaboration. Enabling seamless, secure and convenient payment experiences in public transportation is becoming increasingly important for international travelers and local communities alike. This milestone represents another meaningful step toward making urban mobility more accessible and user-friendly through innovative payment technology.”
In May 2024, Nexi, JCB, and UnionPay International introduced this payment model for the first time in Europe within public transport in Rome, marking a significant milestone in the innovation of urban mobility services.
